full_judgment: 15. Consulting the important documentary evidence `Arpannama'(exhibit-5) it is apparent that it is a registered document of the year 1942 and it was produced before the court of law from the proper custody and admittedly it was marked exhibit after due process of law. The legal presumption of its genuineness under Section 60 of the Registration Act and under the purview of Section 90 of the Evidence Act (I of 1872) lies in favour of the plaintiffs and the very aspect has been totally ignored from the side of the learned courts below. Let as now look into the Vested Property Act which is prevailing at present in the country.
